description: Look up an EVM transaction by transaction hash and return normalized transaction facts, including status, block number, sender, recipient, value, gas usage, and contract method selector. This is a factual post-transaction lookup on Ethereum or Base; live chain state may change between calls and does not simulate, send, sign, or evaluate whether the transaction was safe or appropriate to execute. USE WHEN: an agent already has an EVM transaction hash and needs to inspect the corresponding on-chain transaction. DO NOT USE WHEN: the agent needs a pre-execution transaction decision, a gas-price lookup, a wallet-balance lookup, or the latest block. A syntactically valid hash that is not found on the selected network returns NOT_FOUND as a factual result rather than a validation error.
name: evm_transaction_hash_lookup

block_number.description: Block number where the transaction was included.

contract.description: Contract interaction details detected from calldata.

method_selector.description: First 4 bytes of calldata for contract calls.

gas.description: Gas usage and fee details of the transaction.

effective_gas_price_wei.description: Effective gas price paid per unit of gas.

observed_at.description: UTC observation timestamp in ISO-8601 format with Z suffix.

to_address.description: Transaction recipient address (null for contract creation).

title: EVM Transaction Hash Lookup
